title: microcala quadrangularis
intro: Microcala quadrangularis, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a plant species belonging to the family Hydrocotylaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Indian pennywort are attributed to its ability to stimulate collagen synthesis, promote wound healing, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its various health benefits and therapeutic actions.
